title: Best Juicers for Fresh Juice at Home (2026)
summary: Fresh juice sounds easy until you buy a juicer that clogs, screams at 6 a.m. or leaves half the juice in the pulp. We narrowed it to 6 juicers that independent testers rate well, from a hands-free cold press to a cheap, fast centrifugal. Pick the wrong type and you will end up with a juicer that lives in the cupboard.

verdict.line: If you juice regularly and can pay for a premium machine, get this one: Tom's Guide named it the best juicer it has tested, and Nama backs it with a 15-year warranty. The catch: it is expensive, and unlike the J2 its lid has no hole for feeding in more ingredients while juicing.

method: We started from Tom's Guide's hands-on juicer tests and Consumer Reports' lab results, plus BestReviews' picks. Slow cold-press juicers are ranked for yield and juice quality, and fast centrifugal ones for speed and ease. Each pick suits a different kind of juicer.
assumptions: Prices change often, so check the current price on Amazon before you buy. Yields and noise figures come from the testers' write-ups and depend on what produce you juice.

products.amazon_listing: Nama J3 - Compact cold press juicer - Hands-free - White | Designed for Smaller Kitchens -
products.desc: Cold-press juicer with a 130-watt motor, two filter sizes, fully removable parts and a 15-year warranty. It weighs 9.7 pounds, is smaller than the Nama J2, and lets you add your ingredients in one go.
products.benefit: If you want fresh juice or nut milk without it turning into a chore, you load the ingredients once and it works on its own, and the parts rinse clean with very few grooves for fiber to cling to. Its 15-year warranty means it can stay in your kitchen for years. Plan to tip it to get all the juice out and to top up the hopper for bigger batches.

products.amazon_listing: Nama J2 - Cold Press Juicer - Hands-Free - Black | Wide Mouth Hopper fits a whole recipe -
products.desc: Cold-press juicer with a 200-watt motor that turns its auger at 50 rpm and a wide self-feeding hopper that holds a full batch. It is larger than the J3.

Consumer Reports named it its top overall juicer, and BestReviews calls it the best overall cold press juicer it has reviewed, with an extraction that often leaves nearly dry pulp. It is a premium purchase, so it makes sense for regular juicers.

tips.title: 5 mistakes that put a juicer in the cupboard
items: Buying the wrong type for your produce.
For spinach, kale and celery, choose a cold-press (masticating) juicer. Centrifugal ones often throw light leaves into the pulp bin.
Tom's Guide says centrifugal juicers can sound like a loud blender, while slow juicers measured as low as 60 dB. Check this if you juice early in the morning.
If it takes ten minutes to clean, you will stop using it. Rinse the parts right after juicing, because pulp dries hard.
The Nama J3 has a 15-year warranty, while the AMZCHEF has none. On a juicer you plan to use often, that matters.
Centrifugal juice should be drunk right away. Cold-press juice keeps in the fridge for up to 72 hours, according to Tom's Guide.

faq: What is the best juicer overall?
The Nama J3 was Tom's Guide's best juicer overall, and Consumer Reports picked the larger Nama J2 as its top overall juicer.
Cold press gives more juice, quieter operation and better results with greens. Centrifugal is faster and cheaper but louder.
What is the cheapest decent juicer?
The Hamilton Beach Big Mouth is the lowest-priced juicer in Consumer Reports' lineup, and the AMZCHEF is a cheap slow juicer that surprised Tom's Guide.
Which juicer is best for leafy greens?
A cold-press juicer. Tom's Guide found the Hamilton Beach below average with leafy greens.
Can a juicer make nut milk?
Some can. Tom's Guide found the Nama J3 made some of the creamiest nut milk it has tried.
intro: The biggest choice is the type of juicer. Tom's Guide notes that slow cold-press (masticating) juicers extract more juice, handle leafy greens better and give juice that keeps in the fridge for up to 72 hours, while fast centrifugal ones are cheaper and quicker but louder, and you should drink the juice right away.
